profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Specialties: MongoDB; COTS Integration; Custom Java Integration; Web Application Hosting; Web Analytics; Troubleshooting;

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
Deployed as part of a team supporting internal Cloud and Big Data investment projects.
• Researched the Chef open source software product to streamline, standardize, and
document the configuration of Ubuntu 10.04 servers.
• Researched the Hadoop distributed file system in order to build and deploy it to a
small Cloud environment.

positions.title: Senior Software Systems Engineer
positions.description:
Supported high availability, production web farms for ICE across multiple platforms and environments on a 24x7 basis.

Reviewed architecture of new applications to determine if they conformed to ICE standards and industry best practices.
Deployed custom Java web applications to the WebSphere Application Server and WebSphere Process Server environments.  Reviewed logs and solved problems as needed to ensure applications were functioning as designed.
Conducted WebSphere DataPower SOA device deployments.
Reviewed application code to identify potential issues.  Alerted development team and customers to any potential threats to the host environments.  Recommended improvements to applications to improve performance, scalability, and availability.
Constructed multiple ESRI ArcGIS Server environments.  Set up ArcGIS web services and map caches for use by ICE applications.  Optimized cache for re-use and growth of the environment to maximize potential of the investment.
Maintained and administrated various analytics software packages (Net Insight, WebTrends).  Provided statistics and analysis as needed to multiple customer bases.  
Investigated outages of application deployed to a SOA architecture.
Setup and configured (including security settings) various SFTP shares within the ICE environment
Documented, maintained, and monitored process to transfer and archive over 7 years worth of IIS logs to SAN storage device.  Used logs to compile analytics and assist in investigations for fraudulent use of web applications.  Reviewed logs to identify technical problems not detected by remote monitoring. 
Maintained and upgraded NetScout devices (AFMONs, InfiniStreams).  Used WireShark for analysis of packet captures of TCP/IP traffic to identify application related network problems, monitor traffic, and recommend courses of action.
Wrote modest shells scripts to support processes in a RHEL environment.
Worked with various vendors to correct issues with COTS products

positions.title: Senior Software Systems Engineer
positions.description: Worked under minimal supervision to update and deploy HTML to the ICE / INS public website and various ICE Intranet sites using TeamSite content management software.

positions.title: Instructional Designer
positions.description: Developed educational material for the AMYSIS3000 software.
